decisions.reason: The accelerator program sits farthest from the firm's machinery core and needs little capital, but it is visibly promoted on the home page and fits the green-ecosystem image management has announced, so it is likely kept for now.

The CO2-negative bitumen binder is peripheral to plastic and oil recycling and has only a page of its own rather than home-page presence, but R&D spent on it and early-stage market slowness that can be blamed on temporary causes favour persisting.

The infectious waste plant is a publicly announced partnership with ERMAFA, promoted as revolutionary on the home page and close to the core WASTX line, so the visible commitment and sunk development costs strongly favour keeping it.

The WASTX SNOWFLAKE mobile recycling plant is central to the announced decentralized recycling strategy, highlighted as the latest product, and builds directly on core competence, so dropping it is very unlikely.
